title: Magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator
abstract: arXiv:2608.27011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-frequency artificial phononic crystals offer a low-loss platform compatible with on-chip integration, yet realizing Chern phononic phases at GHz frequencies remains challenging. Here, we propose a magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator in a honeycomb phononic crystal hybridized with ferromagnetic islands at the hexagon centers. A circularly polarized Kittel mode couples to the surrounding phonons with a phase winding, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and opens a full Chern gap. In the large-detuning regime, this mechanism leads to an effective Haldane-type phononic model with magnon-induced complex hopping. By tuning the magnon-phonon interaction, the full hybrid system accesses Chern phases with tunable Chern numbers |C|=1 and |C|=2. translated_title: 磁振子诱导的声子陈绝缘体
translated_abstract: 高频人工声子晶体为片上集成提供了低损耗平台，但在GHz频率下实现陈声子相仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出了一种在蜂窝声子晶体中与六边形中心铁磁岛杂化的磁振子诱导声子陈绝缘体。圆偏振基特尔模式与周围声子耦合，形成相位缠绕，打破时间反演对称性并打开完整的陈能隙。在大失谐区域，该机制产生有效的Haldane型声子模型，具有磁振子诱导的复跳跃。通过调节磁振子-声子相互作用，完整杂化系统可访问具有可调陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的陈相。预测的能隙可超过实际声子和磁振子线宽，使其在GHz声学器件中可观测。我们的工作确立了手性磁振子-声子杂化作为实现陈声子相的一条途径。
tldr: 本文提出一种通过磁振子-声子杂化在GHz频率下实现可调陈数声子陈绝缘体的新机制，为片上声子拓扑器件开辟了道路。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a new mechanism to realize phononic Chern insulators with tunable Chern numbers at GHz frequencies via magnon-phonon hybridization, paving the way for on-chip topological phononic devices.
